The complete first-entrance distribution and its sharp exponential tail quantify approach to the period-three continuum, while the universal singular landing distribution identifies how exceptional long transients select a golden-ratio phase geometry independent of smooth input densities. It is a natural complete hitting invariant and genuine conditional limit, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputed known table.
